serviceUrl.description: The IBM Secrets Manager service URL (only present when configured)

login.description: The login method (only present when configured)

refreshEnabled.description: Whether secret refresh is enabled (only present when configured)

eventStreamTopic.description: The event stream topic (only present when refresh is enabled)

eventStreamBootstrapServers.description: The event stream bootstrap servers (only present when refresh is enabled)

lastCheckTimestamp.description: Epoch time in milliseconds of the last check (only present when known)

lastCheckAge.description: Relative age of the last check (only present when known)

lastReloadTimestamp.description: Epoch time in milliseconds of the last reload (only present when known)

lastReloadAge.description: Relative age of the last reload (only present when known)

timestamp.description: Epoch time in milliseconds of the last update (only present when known)

age.description: Relative age of the last update (only present when known)

secrets.description: The secrets in use (only present when there are any)
